Import from `"rive/host"`. Declares: `Context`, `Converter`, `DecodedImage`, `ImageDecodeListener`, `Interpolator`, `Layout`, `ListenerAction`, `Node`, `PathEffect`, `Protocol`, `Transition`, `TransitionChild`, `TransitionCondition`

```as
/// Raw decoded image pixels, delivered by `Context.decodeImage` to an
/// `ImageDecodeListener`.
export class DecodedImage {
    /// Width in pixels.
    width: u32;

    /// Height in pixels.
    height: u32;

    /// Premultiplied RGBA8 pixel data, `width * height * 4` bytes.
    data: ArrayBuffer;
}

/// Receives the result of `Context.decodeImage`. Extend it and override the
/// callbacks you need; both fire on a later advance.
/// ```as
/// class AvatarDecode extends ImageDecodeListener {
///     width: u32 = 0;
///     height: u32 = 0;
///
///     override onImageDecoded(image: DecodedImage): void {
///         this.width = image.width;
///         this.height = image.height;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class ImageDecodeListener {
    /// Called with the decoded pixels when a decode succeeds.
    onImageDecoded(image: DecodedImage): void;

    /// Called with a description of the error when a decode fails.
    onImageDecodeFailed(message: string): void;
}

/// The bridge between a script and the Rive runtime, passed to `init`. It
/// gives access to:
/// - Update scheduling: request an `update` on the next frame.
/// - Data: the view models bound to the script's object or the root
///   artboard.
/// - Assets: the images, fonts, audio, blobs and shaders added to the file.
/// - Canvases: offscreen 2D and GPU render targets.
export class Context {
    /// Logs a message through the host: the CLI watch log and problems
    /// surface, or the editor console.
    /// ```as
    /// override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///     context.log("hello");
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    log(message: string): void;

    /// Marks the object as needing an update on the next frame. Call it when
    /// something has changed, for example from an event handler, and the
    /// runtime should call `update` again.
    ///
    /// Calls from inside `update` are ignored. Use it from `init`,
    /// `advance`, listener callbacks or event handlers instead.
    /// ```as
    /// override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
    ///     this.elapsed += seconds;
    ///     let context = this.context;
    ///     if (context != null) {
    ///         context.markNeedsUpdate();
    ///     }
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    markNeedsUpdate(): void;

    /// Returns the image asset with the given name, or null if not found.
    /// Draw it with `Renderer.drawImage`. See also `ImageSampler`.
    /// ```as
    /// export class DrawImage extends Node {
    ///     myImage: Image? = null;
    ///     sampler: ImageSampler = ImageSampler(ImageWrap.clamp, ImageWrap.clamp, ImageFilter.bilinear);
    ///
    ///     override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///         this.myImage = context.image("myImage");
    ///         return true;
    ///     }
    ///
    ///     override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
    ///         let image = this.myImage;
    ///         if (image != null) {
    ///             renderer.drawImage(image, this.sampler, BlendMode.srcOver, 1);
    ///         }
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    image(name: string): Image?;

    /// Returns the font asset with the given name, or null if not found.
    /// ```as
    /// let font = context.font("Inter");
    /// if (font != null) {
    ///     let style = new TextRunStyle(font);
    ///     style.size = 24;
    /// }
    /// ```
    font(name: string): Font?;

    /// Returns the audio asset with the given name, or null if not found.
    /// Play it with the `Audio` functions.
    /// ```as
    /// export class AudioExample extends Node {
    ///     source: AudioSource? = null;
    ///
    ///     override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///         this.source = context.audio("myAudio");
    ///         return true;
    ///     }
    ///
    ///     override pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    ///         let source = this.source;
    ///         if (source != null) {
    ///             Audio.play(source);
    ///         }
    ///         event.hit();
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    audio(name: string): AudioSource?;

    /// Returns the `ViewModel` bound to the object's immediate data context,
    /// or null before data binds. This is the most common way to read data
    /// bound properties from a script.
    /// ```as
    /// override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///     let vm = context.viewModel();
    ///     if (vm != null) {
    ///         this.cannon = vm.getTrigger("cannon");
    ///     }
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    viewModel(): ViewModel?;

    /// Returns the `ViewModel` bound to the root artboard's data context, or
    /// null if there is none. Useful for reaching top level data from a
    /// deeply nested object.
    /// ```as
    /// let vm = context.rootViewModel();
    /// if (vm != null) {
    ///     let score = vm.getNumber("score");
    /// }
    /// ```
    rootViewModel(): ViewModel?;

    /// Returns the global `ViewModel` with the given name, or null if there is
    /// no global view model by that name or none is currently bound. Global
    /// view models are shared, singleton like view models addressed by name
    /// rather than through the object's own data context.
    /// ```as
    /// let settings = context.globalViewModel("AppSettings");
    /// if (settings != null) {
    ///     let volume = settings.getNumber("volume");
    /// }
    /// ```
    globalViewModel(name: string): ViewModel?;

    /// Returns the names of all global view models defined in the file, in
    /// file order. Pass any of them to `globalViewModel` to fetch that view
    /// model. Returns an empty array when the file defines none.
    /// ```as
    /// let names = context.globalViewModelNames();
    /// for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    ///     context.log(names[i]);
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe globalViewModelNames(): Array<string>;

    /// Returns the data context provided to this object, or null if there is
    /// none.
    /// ```as
    /// let dc = context.dataContext();
    /// if (dc != null) {
    ///     let parent = dc.parent();
    ///     let vm = dc.viewModel();
    /// }
    /// ```
    dataContext(): DataContext?;

    /// Creates a 2D `Canvas` for Rive Renderer drawing, or returns null when
    /// the host cannot create one. Draw into it with `beginFrame` and
    /// `endFrame` during `draw`.
    ///
    /// A zero width or height, the default, creates a deferred canvas with no
    /// backing texture, useful in layouts that do not know their size at
    /// `init`. Call `resize` once the size is known. While deferred, `width`
    /// and `height` read 0 and `beginFrame` returns null.
    /// ```as
    /// override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///     this.canvas = context.canvas(256, 256);
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    ///
    /// override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
    ///     let canvas = this.canvas;
    ///     if (canvas == null) {
    ///         return;
    ///     }
    ///     let frame = canvas.beginFrame(0xFF202020);
    ///     if (frame != null) {
    ///         frame.drawPath(this.path, this.paint);
    ///         canvas.endFrame();
    ///     }
    ///     renderer.drawImage(canvas.image, ImageSampler(), BlendMode.srcOver, 1);
    /// }
    /// ```
    canvas(width: u32 = 0, height: u32 = 0): Canvas?;

    /// Creates a `GPUCanvas`, a 1x presentation target, or returns null when
    /// the host cannot create one. Render to it with `beginRenderPass`. For
    /// MSAA, allocate the multisampled color and depth textures yourself and
    /// resolve into the canvas.
    ///
    /// A zero width or height, the default, creates a deferred canvas with no
    /// backing texture, useful in layouts that do not know their size at
    /// `init`. Call `resize` once the size is known. While deferred, `width`
    /// and `height` read 0 and `view` is null.
    gpuCanvas(width: u32 = 0, height: u32 = 0): GPUCanvas?;

    /// Returns Rive's own render target: passes into it land under all of
    /// Rive's content. It cannot be sampled and starts each frame undefined,
    /// so the first pass must clear or cover it. With a `sampleCount` of 1 it
    /// can resolve a script's MSAA texture. On a frame the host hides it,
    /// `view` is null and passes into it are dropped.
    ///
    /// Returns null where the host can never expose one; keep a `gpuCanvas`
    /// and draw its image instead.
    gpuTarget(): GPUTarget?;

    /// Returns the GPU features and limits the current backend supports.
    features(): GPUFeatures;

    /// Returns the bytes of the blob asset with the given name, or null if
    /// not found or empty. Useful for loading custom data files embedded in
    /// the Rive file. The blob's size is the buffer's `byteLength`.
    /// ```as
    /// let bytes = context.blob("myBlob");
    /// if (bytes != null && bytes.byteLength > 0) {
    ///     let first = Uint8Array.wrap(bytes)[0];
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe blob(name: string): ArrayBuffer?;

    /// Returns the compiled shader modules for the current backend from the
    /// shader asset with the given name (as added in the editor, with no
    /// `.wgsl` extension), ready for a `GPUPipelineDesc`. Returns null when
    /// the asset is not found or was not compiled for this backend.
    unsafe shader(name: string): GPUShaderModule?;

    /// Decodes compressed image data (PNG, JPEG or WebP) into premultiplied
    /// RGBA8 pixels. The listener receives the `DecodedImage`, or the error,
    /// on a later advance.
    ///
    /// Returns a token for `cancelImageDecode`. Returns 0 when this platform
    /// cannot decode images, after calling the listener's
    /// `onImageDecodeFailed`.
    /// ```as
    /// let bytes = context.blob("avatar");
    /// if (bytes != null) {
    ///     this.decodeToken = context.decodeImage(bytes, new AvatarDecode());
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe decodeImage(bytes: ArrayBuffer, listener: ImageDecodeListener): u32;

    /// Cancels a pending decode started by `decodeImage`. Its listener is not
    /// called.
    cancelImageDecode(token: u32): void;

    /// Decodes the bytes of a .riv file, such as a `fetch` response body.
    /// The promise resolves with the file, or rejects with
    /// "malformed: <message>" or "unsupportedVersion: <message>". It may
    /// settle on a later frame, so wait for it with `await` or `andThen`
    /// rather than reading its status right away. Only assets embedded in the
    /// file load, and its scripts run only if Rive signed them.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// async loadCharacter(context: Context): Promise<void> {
    ///     let vm = context.viewModel();
    ///     if (vm == null) {
    ///         return;
    ///     }
    ///     let character = vm.getArtboard("character");
    ///     let response = await fetch("https://example.com/a.riv");
    ///     let file = await context.decodeFile(await response.arrayBuffer());
    ///     if (character != null) {
    ///         character.value = file.bindableArtboard();
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    decodeFile(bytes: ArrayBuffer): Promise<RiveFile>;

    /// Returns the id of the shader asset with the given name, or 0 when the
    /// file has none. Modules returned by `shader` already carry it.
    shaderAssetId(name: string): u32;
}

/// The hooks every script shares. A script extends one of its subclasses,
/// `Node`, `Layout`, `Converter`, `PathEffect`, `ListenerAction`,
/// `TransitionCondition` or `Interpolator`, never `Protocol` itself.
///
/// Override only the hooks the script needs; the host calls only those.
/// Abstract hooks such as `Converter.convert` are required. Declare inputs
/// as fields marked `@input`.
/// ```as
/// export class MyNode extends Node {
///     @input speed: f64 = 1;
///     @input title: string = "Rive";
///     @input enabled: bool = false;
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         return true;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class Protocol {
    /// Called once when the script is created. Return true if
    /// initialization succeeds, or false to stop the script.
    /// ```as
    /// override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///     this.context = context;
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    init(context: Context): bool;

    /// Called every frame to advance the script over time. `seconds` is the
    /// time since the previous frame. Return true to keep receiving advance
    /// calls.
    /// ```as
    /// override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
    ///     this.elapsed += seconds;
    ///     return true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    advance(seconds: f64): bool;

    /// Called once when the host drops the script, for example when its
    /// artboard is disposed or the editor reloads. Release long lived
    /// resources here.
    dispose(): void;
}

/// A script that renders shapes, images, text, artboards and more. A
/// scripted node can be attached to any Node and renders in the local
/// transform space of the hosting Node.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`.
/// ```as
/// export class Spinner extends Node {
///     @input speed: f64 = 1;
///     angle: f64 = 0;
///     path: Path = new Path();
///     paint: Paint = new Paint();
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         this.paint.color = Color.rgba(255, 180, 90, 255);
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
///         this.angle += seconds * this.speed;
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
///         let x = <f32>(Math.cos(this.angle) * 50);
///         let y = <f32>(Math.sin(this.angle) * 50);
///         this.path.reset();
///         this.path.moveTo(Vector.xy(0, 0));
///         this.path.lineTo(Vector.xy(x, y));
///         this.path.lineTo(Vector.xy(-y, x));
///         this.path.close();
///         renderer.drawPath(this.path, this.paint);
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class Node extends Protocol {
    /// Called when an input value changes, and on the next frame after
    /// `Context.markNeedsUpdate`.
    /// ```as
    /// override update(): void {
    ///     this.dirty = true;
    /// }
    /// ```
    update(): void;

    /// Called every frame, after advance, to render the node with the given
    /// `Renderer`, which is valid only for this call. Work on a `Canvas` or
    /// `GPUCanvas` also happens here, in any order.
    /// ```as
    /// override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
    ///     renderer.drawPath(this.path, this.paint);
    /// }
    /// ```
    draw(renderer: Renderer): void;

    /// Handles a pointer press. Call `event.hit()` to consume it.
    /// ```as
    /// override pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    ///     this.pressedAt = event.position;
    ///     event.hit();
    /// }
    /// ```
    pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void;

    /// Handles a pointer move. Call `event.hit()` to consume it.
    pointerMove(event: PointerEvent): void;

    /// Handles a pointer release. Call `event.hit()` to consume it.
    pointerUp(event: PointerEvent): void;

    /// Handles a pointer leaving. Call `event.hit()` to consume it.
    pointerExit(event: PointerEvent): void;

    /// Handles a mouse wheel or trackpad scroll over the node. Call
    /// `event.hit()` to claim it; otherwise it passes to whatever lies
    /// behind, such as a `ScrollConstraint` view.
    /// ```as
    /// override pointerScroll(event: ScrollEvent): void {
    ///     this.zoom *= Math.exp(-event.delta.y * 0.01);
    ///     event.hit();
    /// }
    /// ```
    pointerScroll(event: ScrollEvent): void;

    /// Handles a keyboard event. Return true to stop it propagating.
    keyboardEvent(event: KeyboardEvent): bool;

    /// Handles text input. Return true to stop it propagating.
    textEvent(event: TextInput): bool;

    /// Called when a gamepad connects, with its full state. Gamepad events
    /// reach the focused node and bubble up.
    gamepadConnected(event: GamepadEvent): void;

    /// Called when a button or axis changes on a connected gamepad. Gamepad
    /// events reach the focused node and bubble up; return true to stop the
    /// bubble.
    gamepadEvent(event: GamepadEvent): bool;

    /// Called when a gamepad disconnects. Gamepad events reach the focused
    /// node and bubble up.
    gamepadDisconnected(event: GamepadEvent): void;
}

/// A `Node` that also fits into a layout box. The host sizes it through
/// `resize`, and it can be intrinsically sized: hosting layouts that fit to
/// their content ask `measure` for the size it wants.
///
/// It inherits every `Node` and `Protocol` hook.
/// ```as
/// export class Panel extends Layout {
///     width: f64 = 0;
///     height: f64 = 0;
///
///     override measure(): Vector {
///         return Vector.xy(100, 100);
///     }
///
///     override resize(width: f64, height: f64, scale: f64): void {
///         this.width = width;
///         this.height = height;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class Layout extends Node {
    /// Returns the size this layout wants to be. It is not guaranteed, as
    /// the layout may have min and max dimensions; `resize` is called with
    /// the granted size after measuring.
    measure(): Vector;

    /// Called with the initial size and again whenever the size changes.
    /// `width` and `height` are in points and `scale` is the presenting
    /// surface's device pixels per point.
    resize(width: f64, height: f64, scale: f64): void;
}

/// A script that transforms values between view model data bindings and
/// Rive properties. Both directions take and return a `DataValue`, or null
/// for no result.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`.
/// ```as
/// export class AddOne extends Converter {
///     override convert(input: DataValue): DataValue? {
///         if (input.isNumber()) {
///             return new DataValueNumber((<DataValueNumber>input).value + 1);
///         }
///         return null;
///     }
///
///     override reverseConvert(input: DataValue): DataValue? {
///         if (input.isNumber()) {
///             return new DataValueNumber((<DataValueNumber>input).value - 1);
///         }
///         return null;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class Converter extends Protocol {
    /// Converts the input value, a view model property, to an output value.
    abstract convert(input: DataValue): DataValue?;

    /// Converts an output value back to an input value, a view model
    /// property.
    reverseConvert(input: DataValue): DataValue?;
}

/// An effect applied to a path. For an effect that changes over time even
/// when the path does not, call `markNeedsUpdate` on its context from
/// `advance`.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`.
/// ```as
/// export class Shrink extends PathEffect {
///     outPath: Path = new Path();
///
///     override update(path: Path, node: PathEffectNode): Path {
///         this.outPath.reset();
///         this.outPath.add(path, Mat2D.withScale(0.5, 0.5));
///         return this.outPath;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class PathEffect extends Protocol {
    /// Called when an input changes or an update is requested. Receives the
    /// original path and the `PathEffectNode` it belongs to, and returns the
    /// path to render.
    abstract update(path: Path, node: PathEffectNode): Path;
}

/// An action performed when its
/// State Machine Listener is triggered.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`.
/// ```as
/// export class CountClicks extends ListenerAction {
///     clicks: i32 = 0;
///
///     override performAction(context: ListenerContext): void {
///         if (context.isPointerEvent()) {
///             this.clicks++;
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class ListenerAction extends Protocol {
    /// Called when the listener is triggered, with the `PointerEvent` that
    /// triggered it. Only called when `performAction` is not overridden.
    /// @[deprecated{ use = "performAction" }]
    perform(event: PointerEvent): void;

    /// Called when the listener is triggered, with a `ListenerContext`
    /// describing the event that triggered it.
    performAction(context: ListenerContext): void;
}

/// A condition a transition between state machine states must meet to be
/// taken.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`.
/// ```as
/// export class WhenReady extends TransitionCondition {
///     @input ready: bool = false;
///
///     override evaluate(): bool {
///         return this.ready;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class TransitionCondition extends Protocol {
    /// Called every frame while the transition is active. Return true to
    /// allow the transition, or false to prevent it.
    abstract evaluate(): bool;
}

/// A custom interpolation curve.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`.
/// ```as
/// export class EaseIn extends Interpolator {
///     override transform(value: f64): f64 {
///         return value * value;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class Interpolator extends Protocol {
    /// Maps linear progress, from 0 to 1, to eased progress.
    abstract transform(value: f64): f64;

    /// Interpolates between `from` and `to` at progress `value`. By default
    /// it applies `transform` to `value` and blends linearly.
    transformValue(from: f64, to: f64, value: f64): f64;
}

/// One child, a nested artboard, of a `Transition`, valid only during the
/// `changed` or `draw` call it is passed to. Draw it with `draw`, wrapping
/// the call in renderer state (save, opacity, transform, clip, restore) to
/// author the transition effect.
export class TransitionChild {
    /// Draws this child's content at the renderer's current transform.
    draw(renderer: Renderer): void;

    /// The child artboard's natural width, useful for slide and scale math.
    get width(): f64;

    /// The child artboard's natural height.
    get height(): f64;
}

/// Renders the visual change between an outgoing (`from`) and incoming
/// (`to`) child when a transition's active child changes. The runtime picks
/// the active child; the script owns how the two are composited. Declare any
/// inputs the effect needs as ordinary `@input` members.
///
/// It inherits `init`, `advance` and `dispose` from `Protocol`. Return true
/// from `advance` while the transition runs and false once it completes,
/// after which the runtime retires the outgoing child.
/// ```as
/// export class Crossfade extends Transition {
///     progress: f64 = 0;
///
///     override changed(from: TransitionChild?,
///                      to: TransitionChild?, direction: f64): void {
///         this.progress = 0;
///     }
///
///     override advance(seconds: f64): bool {
///         this.progress = Math.min(1, this.progress + seconds * 2);
///         return this.progress < 1;
///     }
///
///     override draw(renderer: Renderer, from: TransitionChild?,
///                   to: TransitionChild?): void {
///         if (from != null) {
///             renderer.save();
///             renderer.modulateOpacity(1 - this.progress);
///             from.draw(renderer);
///             renderer.restore();
///         }
///         if (to != null) {
///             renderer.save();
///             renderer.modulateOpacity(this.progress);
///             to.draw(renderer);
///             renderer.restore();
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export abstract class Transition extends Protocol {
    /// When false, the incoming child renders through the artboard's normal
    /// draw loop and `draw` receives null for it, so the script composites
    /// only the outgoing child, as for a reveal. Default true. Read at the
    /// start of each transition, so set it in `init` or `changed`.
    managesTo: bool = true;

    /// Called when the active child changes. `from` is the outgoing child,
    /// null on the first show; `to` is the incoming one. `direction` is 1
    /// when `to` sits at a higher index than `from`, -1 when lower and 0 when
    /// unknown, as on the first show. Reset any progress here. Called again
    /// on interruption, with the previously incoming child as `from`.
    changed(from: TransitionChild?, to: TransitionChild?,
            direction: f64): void;

    /// Composites the two children. Either may be null; see `managesTo`.
    abstract draw(renderer: Renderer, from: TransitionChild?,
                  to: TransitionChild?): void;
}
```
